mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category3 AS category3, city, district, subdistrict, road_address AS roadAddress, postal_code AS postalCode, phone, lat, lon, updated_at AS updatedAt, category_id AS categoryId FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId}

SELECT id, place_id AS placeId, user_id AS userId, rating, content, visit_date AS visitDate, created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT rp.photo_url FROM review_photos rp JOIN reviews r ON rp.review_id = r.id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId}
